tasks.short: Advise the client on space, furnishings, and color.

steps.what: Advise the client on interior design factors.
Advise on space planning and layout.
Advise on furnishings, equipment, and color coordination.
Note the design factors after the advice.

tasks.design: The designer advises the client on space planning, layout, furnishings, equipment, and color coordination. A short note is written after the advice. Nothing sends advice, and the call is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice is the conversation. The note is a few lines afterwards.
tasks.still_hard: Color and layout that the client rejects are heard only in the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The designer advises. The note only records the factors they stated.
tasks.altitude: Advice on planning, layout, furnishings, and color stays with the designer. The note is shorter. Nothing advises for them.

evidence.claim: Advice on space, furnishings, and color is a conversation the designer holds. A note can record the factors they stated. The call is not stored as audio.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the client asks for advice and ends when the designer has noted the factors they advised. The advice stays in the conversation. The call is not recorded.
The note fields are room, the factor, and a short line the designer writes. The designer produces the line. If they skip the note, nothing is generated.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps disagree: advising stays in full, and only a short note afterwards is lighter.
Upkeep is keeping the advice-note headings the office uses.
unknowns: Whether the client expects the advice only from the named designer.
Whether a note is required after every advice call.
research_questions: Does the client expect the advice only from the named designer?
Is a note required after every advice call?

already_counted.description: Advising the client on interior design factors stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the advice-note headings the office uses

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the advice is a long meeting, the low end is the conversation, which stays. The note is the only shorter part. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate contractors, architects, engineers, and plumbers.

steps.what: Ensure success with the other professionals.
Note how they coordinate with those professionals.

tasks.design: The designer coordinates with contractors, architects, engineers, and plumbers, and works to ensure the job succeeds. A short note follows the conversations. Nothing speaks to those professionals, and the calls are not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coordination is the conversation. The note is a few lines afterwards.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new coordinates the other professionals.
tasks.still_hard: A clash between a plumber and a drawing is settled by the people on the call.
tasks.human_edge: The designer coordinates. The note only records what they agreed in person.
tasks.altitude: Coordination stays with the designer. The note is shorter. Nothing contacts a contractor or an architect on its own.

reach.task: Take a point the designer coordinated
reach.learn: The agreement was made with the designer

evidence.claim: Coordinating contractors, architects, engineers, and plumbers is the designer's conversation. A note can record the point they agreed. The calls are not stored as audio.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when another professional needs a decision and ends when the designer has noted the point they coordinated. The conversations stay human and are not recorded.
The note fields are job, professional, and the point the designer writes. The designer produces the point. If they skip the note, nothing is generated.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the coordination. The note is a lighter copy of a point they have already agreed.
Upkeep is keeping the trade headings the office uses on the note.
unknowns: Which professionals must be on the call for this job.
Whether the contract requires a written site instruction as well.
research_questions: Which professionals must be on the call for this job?
Does the contract require a written site instruction as well?

incremental.description: Keep the trade headings the office uses on the note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the clash takes the whole call, the low end is the coordination, which stays. The note is the only shorter part. Provisional, not a measured result.

steps.what: Review shop drawings for construction plans.
Detail shop drawings for the construction.
Mark the drawings that need more detail.
Accept the shop drawings after that detail.

tasks.design: The designer reviews and details the shop drawings for the construction plans, and marks what still needs detail. The file stores the drawings only after they accept them. It does not detail a drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviewing and detailing are the work. Filing the marked set is a second pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A project file can hold shop drawings the designer has already detailed and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A detail that does not fit the plan is the designer's to catch on the sheet.
tasks.human_edge: The designer reviews, details, and accepts the drawings. The file stores that set.
tasks.altitude: Reviewing and detailing shop drawings stay with the designer. The file holds the set only after they accept it.

reach.task: Build from shop drawings the designer detailed

evidence.claim: Shop drawings the designer has reviewed and detailed can be stored after they accept them. A tool does not detail the sheet.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when shop drawings arrive and ends when the accepted set is on the file. Reviewing and detailing stay with the designer.
The fields are sheet, the mark the designer made, and their acceptance. The designer produces the mark. If a sheet is missing, they mark it. Nothing details a drawing.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the review and the detail. They disagree only about filing a set the designer has already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the sheet names aligned with the shop-drawing file.
unknowns: Whether the fabricator must resubmit after each mark.
Which drawings are in the fabricator's standard and must not be redrawn.
research_questions: Must the fabricator resubmit after each mark?
Which drawings are in the fabricator's standard and must not be redrawn?

incremental.description: Keep the sheet names aligned with the shop-drawing file

approvals.approved_version: shop drawings the designer accepted after reviewing and detailing them

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the fabricator must resubmit, that second review stays, and the low end is the review and the detail, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.short: Inspect construction against the design plans.

steps.what: Ensure adherence to the design plans.
Write the site note on construction adherence.
Accept the note after they inspect.

tasks.design: The designer inspects the construction on site and ensures adherence to the design plans. They write the note after that visit and accept it, and only then is the note filed. The visit is not replaced by a photo.
tasks.previous_blocker: The inspection is the visit. The note is often typed a second time back at the office.
tasks.enabler_now: A note written after the visit can be stored once the designer has accepted it.
tasks.still_hard: A finish that does not match the plan is seen on site, not in the note.
tasks.human_edge: The designer inspects and accepts the note. The file stores that note.
tasks.altitude: The site inspection stays with the designer. The file holds the note only after the visit and their acceptance.

reach.learn: The note was written after the visit

evidence.claim: A site note the designer wrote and accepted after inspecting the construction can be stored. The visit itself is not replaced.

The designer judges safety, accessibility, and what the design should be. A tool does not certify compliance and does not generate the design. National rules decide which accessibility and safety duties apply. EU data-protection rules cover a client's home and their preferences. Client conferences are not stored as audio. A drawing or a specification is filed only after the designer made it. This work does not generate or edit an image.

assumptions: The workflow starts when construction is ready to inspect and ends when the accepted note is on the file. The visit stays outside the file step.

The fields are location, what the designer saw, whether it adheres to the plans, and their acceptance. The designer produces the note from the visit. If a line is missing, they type it. Nothing is inferred from a photo.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the inspection. They disagree only about a second typing of a note the designer has already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the room names on the site note aligned with the plans.
unknowns: Whether the contractor must walk the site with the designer.
Which finishes must be seen in person on every visit.
research_questions: Must the contractor walk the site with the designer?
Which finishes must be seen in person on every visit?

already_counted.description: Inspecting construction work on site stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the room names on the site note aligned with the plans

approvals.approved_version: site note the designer accepted after inspecting the construction

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the note is already written on site, the low end is the inspection, which stays. Only a clean copy of a note accepted after the visit is shorter. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Advice, coordination, shop drawings, and the site inspection stay with the designer. A drawing or a site note is filed only after they have done the work and accepted the note. Calls are not recorded.
reach: A fabricator builds from shop drawings the designer detailed
A contractor corrects work the designer inspected on site
skills_to_grow: Advising in the conversation, not in a generated reply
Detailing shop drawings before they are filed
Accepting a site note only after the inspection
role.ambitious_version: Every site note was accepted after the designer inspected the work, and every shop drawing was detailed by them.
